title: Riot Squad BAR EDTN Pineapple Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid 10mg
description: Pineapple Ice from Riot Squad’s BAR EDTN collection delivers a vibrant burst of tropical flavour that’s as refreshing as it is sweet and tangy. The fresh, juicy taste of Pineapple is elevated by a frosty layer of menthol, providing an ice-cool finish with every exhale. This e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend ensures an ideal balance of flavour and vapour production, while the nicotine salt formula offers a smooth and satisfying throat hit. Riot Squad’s BAR EDTN e-liquids are designed for use with starter vape kits and low-powered pod systems. Unlike standard freebase e-liquids, nicotine salts have an alkaline formulation that allows for higher nicotine concentrations without the harsh throat hit. Nicotine salt e-liquids provide faster nicotine absorption, offering quick relief from cravings. This makes Nic salt e-liquids an excellent option for recent ex-smokers or vapers looking for immediate and satisfying nicotine delivery. BAR EDTN is a delectable collection of nic salt e-liquids inspired by Riot Squad’s popular disposable Riot Bar flavours. Like the Riot Bars, Bar EDTN keeps the flavours simple, sweet, and consistently satisfying, so you always know what to expect. Enjoy this Pineapple Ice flavour and explore the rest of Riot Squad’s BAR EDTN range, including refreshing Watermelon Ice, classic Cherry Cola, and smooth Mango Vanilla. Whatever your preference, BAR EDTN offers an incredible flavour to suit your taste.
